xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4584: Archiving a conversation shows no feedback until the row disappears; failures are silent

plan.title: Archiving a conversation shows no feedback until the row disappears; failures are silent
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: After the operator confirms an archive, nothing visible happens for several seconds until the row disappears, because the server ends the session before replying. archiveMutation has no onError, archiveConversation drops the server's error message, ConversationPanel.handleArchive uses a raw fetch that ignores res.ok, and the Stage tab action menu closes the tab before the request resolves.
narratives.Proposal: Give archiveMutation mutationKey ['conversation-archive'] and derive archive-pending names from the shared TanStack MutationCache with useMutationState, so all seven useConversationMutations instances see the same pending state. Guard duplicate archives with a call-time queryClient.isMutating check. Toast success ('Archived "<title>"') and failure (server message). Render pending on the row (Loader2 status, muted title, aria-busy), disable Archive items in all menus, show 'Archiving…' in the panel header, route ConversationPanel through the shared hook with a per-call onSuccess for onArchived, and stop the tab menu from closing the tab eagerly. Full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-4584.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No optimistic removal of the row; it stays until the server confirms
- No change to the archive server route, archiveConversationByName, or its timing
- No change to stop, retitle, favorite, move or fork behavior; retitle keeps its per-instance ref
- No pending indicator on Stage tab labels themselves
- No confirm dialog added to the panel body Archive buttons
- No new CSS classes
- No edits to the OKF knowledge bundle (../overdeck-knowledge)

autoDecisions.summary: Archive-pending state lives in the TanStack MutationCache (mutationKey ['conversation-archive'] + useMutationState), not a per-instance ref like retitle
autoDecisions.rationale: Seven separate useConversationMutations instances exist; the Stage tab menu and ConversationPanel use different instances from ConversationList, so a per-instance ref could never show pending on the row as the issue requires.

autoDecisions.summary: The panel header shows Archiving… whenever its conversation is archive-pending, from any entry point
autoDecisions.rationale: Pending state is global, and showing it consistently is a superset of the issue's 'if triggered from there' that keeps every entry point identical (issue AC: all entry points share the same behavior).

autoDecisions.summary: ConversationActionMenu stops calling onCloseTab right after archive; the hook's closeConversationPanes closes the tab on success
autoDecisions.rationale: Closing the tab before the request resolves breaks the issue's failure requirement (row and view stay on failure); closeConversationPanes already closes the same agent pane.

autoDecisions.summary: ConversationPanel passes onArchived as a per-call onSuccess on archive(name, { onSuccess })
autoDecisions.rationale: Smallest API change that fires onArchived (standalone window.close) only on success; the standalone panel stays mounted so per-call callbacks fire.

autoDecisions.summary: Toast copy and durations follow existing mutations: success 'Archived "<title>"' 4000 ms, error server message 6000 ms
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue specifies the success text; durations match retitleMutation and moveMutation in the same file.

items.title: Share archive-pending state across hook instances and toast archive outcomes

expected_outputs: all five listed test files pass

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4584.md). In useConversationMutations.ts: archiveConversation parses the JSON body and throws data?.error || 'Failed to archive conversation'; add ARCHIVE_MUTATION_KEY = ['conversation-archive']; archiveMutation gets mutationKey, onMutate returning { title } looked up from the ['conversations'] cache (fallback name), onSuccess adds toast.success(`Archived "${title}"`, { duration: 4000 }) after the existing invalidate/closeConversationPanes/selection clear, onError toast.error(err.message, { duration: 6000 }). Derive pendingArchiveNames with useMutationState({ filters: { mutationKey, status: 'pending' }, select: m => m.state.variables as string }). ConversationMutations gains archive(name, options?: { onSuccess?: () => void }) and isArchivePending(name). archive() returns early when queryClient.isMutating({ mutationKey, predicate: m => m.state.variables === name }) > 0, else archiveMutate(name, options?.onSuccess ? { onSuccess: () => options.onSuccess?.() } : undefined). Add pendingArchiveNames and queryClient to the useMemo deps. Add isArchivePending: vi.fn(() => false) to the hand-built mutation mocks in ConversationRow.test.tsx (~line 50) and VaultBrowseCopy.test.tsx (~line 79).

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. New file cloned from useConversationMutations.move.test.tsx scaffolding (sonner mock, ../../../lib/panesStore mock, fetch stub, conv() factory, seeded ['conversations'] cache). Five cases: pending visible before resolve; cross-instance pending and no second fetch; same-act double call sends one fetch; success toasts 'Archived "Alpha"' with duration 4000, calls closeConversationPanes and the per-call onSuccess, clears pending; error toasts the server message with duration 6000 (fallback 'Failed to archive conversation' for a non-JSON body), skips closeConversationPanes and onSuccess, clears pending.
